scope: Read-only input review of magnetic-bilayer, hydrodynamic-heating and circular-detector. Full public instructions, README, starter, public tests, data keys and Docker boundary were read, with private grading inspected for extra implementation restrictions. No task source was changed.
limits: This audits source packaging and stated physics, not adversarial container isolation or every possible statistical side channel.
A completed predictor with a fit-only placeholder can still anchor an agent; the identical neutral instruction explicitly permits replacing all helpers. Behavioral neutrality is not guaranteed.
Required fitted attributes, API, units, preparation ranges and output accuracy remain legitimate restrictions. No solver, basis, discretization or internal model form is tested.
Native prompt evidence is included only if a matching current-source session exists at this snapshot; running-session hashes are provisional until the terminal trial audit.
